name: Reconcile Expected and Completed Records
description: Compare expected and completed string IDs. Stop on missing, unexpected or duplicate records, even when counts match. Fictional local demo; no accounts, network requests or credentials.

parameters.content:
## Equal counts can still hide missing work
Run the healthy demo. Then change demoCase in Choose a demo to wrong_ids, missing, duplicates or empty.

wrong_ids returns three records for three expected IDs, but one ID is missing and another is unexpected. The workflow must fail. Inspect Reconcile record IDs for the difference.

All example IDs are fictional. No account or external request is required.

nodes.name: Stop on incomplete or duplicate work

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'Record reconciliation failed: ' + $json.missingIds.length + ' missing; ' + $json.unexpectedIds.length + ' unexpected; ' + $json.duplicateExpectedIds.length + ' repeated expected IDs; ' + $json.duplicateCompletedIds.length + ' repeated completed IDs; empty expected rejected: ' + $json.emptyExpectedRejected + '. Inspect Reconcile record IDs.' }}

parameters.content:
## Connect one completed batch
Replace the demo with ONE item containing expectedIds, completedIds and allowEmptyExpected. Capture expected IDs before processing; read completed IDs from confirmed downstream results, not attempted inputs. Compare once after the whole batch or loop finishes. Preserve the envelope even if completedIds is [].

Use nonblank strings. Numeric IDs need an explicit mapping, such as String(id), on both sides. Comparison is exact and case sensitive; order is ignored. Rejects duplicates on either side. Maximum 10,000 IDs per array. Empty expected IDs fail unless allowEmptyExpected is explicitly true.

If a prior node returns zero n8n items, this node will not run. Keep the envelope on a control path or deliberately use Always Output Data and rebuild it; a bare {} is invalid. If filtering is intentional, define the expected eligible batch before processing.

## What this proves
Identity coverage of the arrays you supply. It does not verify database commits, record contents, exactly-once effects, or a workflow that never reaches this check. Stop And Error intentionally fails mismatched demos. A separate Error Trigger workflow can notify on automatic failed runs; it does not fire for manual test executions.

For independent expected-run monitoring, [Keptick setup](https://keptick.aifirm.app/guide?utm_source=github&utm_medium=template&utm_campaign=e08_n8n_record_reconciliation) is optional. This template contains no HTTP node or telemetry. Review IDs before sharing execution data.
